ev.q: During 2019–2020, the percentage of U.S. adults aged 18–64 years who were uninsured was 14.4%.
Among all race and Hispanic origin subgroups, those most likely to be uninsured were Hispanic adults (30.4%)
the percentage of U.S. adults aged 18–64 years who were uninsured was 14.4%
Adults of Cuban (22.7%) origin were more likely to be uninsured than those of Puerto Rican (14.8%)
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population
